paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: : Search space of the dataset under different configurations.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of missing pieces and the number of possible solutions for the M-Cube dataset. The x-axis is labeled "# Missing pieces", has a linear scale, ranges from 1 to 6, and has tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "# Possible solutions", has a logarithmic scale with major tick labels at 10<sup>2</sup>, 10<sup>4</sup>, 10<sup>6</sup>, and 10<sup>8</sup>, and ranges from approximately 10<sup>1</sup> to 10<sup>8</sup>. A light blue line, marked with circular data points, begins at approximately (1, 15) and increases to approximately (6, 6,000,000). An orange line, also marked with circular data points, begins at approximately (1, 22) and increases to approximately (6, 8,000,000). Both lines exhibit a generally increasing trend across the x-axis.
